info.name: Fahimni — Quiz Generation & Submission E2E
info.description: Direct-run E2E for STORY-45/47/48. Import the populated local environment, select it, and run the 'RUN DIRECT — Quiz Generation and Submission E2E' folder. No IDs, bodies, answers, or grades are entered manually — every runtime value is captured by scripts. Auth uses the HttpOnly access_token cookie via Newman's cookie jar; each role logs in immediately before its requests.

exec: // Collection-level security scan — runs after every request.
pm.test('No secret leakage in response', function () {

item.name: RUN DIRECT — Quiz Generation and Submission E2E
item.description: Select the populated local environment and click Run. No IDs, bodies, answers, or grades need to be entered manually.

exec: pm.test('question ids + quizId mapping', () => qs.forEach(q => { pm.expect(q.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(q.quizId).to.eql(data.id); }));

pm.test('MCQ options valid (>=2 distinct)', () => qs.filter(q=>q.type==='MCQ').forEach(q=>{ const o=Array.isArray(q.options)?q.options:Object.values(q.options||{}); pm.expect(o.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(new Set(o.map(String)).size).to.eql(o.length); }));

pm.test('ESSAY options empty/null', () => qs.filter(q=>q.type==='ESSAY').forEach(q=>{ const o=q.options; pm.expect(o===null || (Array.isArray(o)&&o.length===0) || (o&&Object.keys(o).length===0)).to.be.true; }));
pm.test('no duplicate question content', () => { const c=qs.map(q=>(q.content||'').trim()); pm.expect(new Set(c).size).to.eql(c.length); });
pm.test('published quiz appears', () => pm.expect(pub, 'published quiz in chapter').to.be.an('object'));
const ESSAY_TEXT = 'إجابة تجريبية مكتملة لاختبار رحلة تسليم الاختبار والتصحيح اليدوي.';
function optsOf(q){ return Array.isArray(q.options) ? q.options : (q.options && typeof q.options==='object' ? Object.values(q.options) : []); }
if (q.type === 'MCQ') { const o = optsOf(q); return { questionId: q.id, answer: String(o[0]) }; }
pm.test('built full + partial answer arrays', () => { pm.expect(answers.length).to.be.above(1); pm.expect(partial.length).to.eql(answers.length-1); });
pm.test('safe error envelope', () => pm.expect(json.success === false || json.message).to.be.ok);
pm.test('each result has valid state', () => results.forEach(r => pm.expect(['correct','incorrect','pending']).to.include(r.result)));
const grades = pending.map(r=>({ questionId: r.questionId, awardedPoints: 0, feedback: 'تم التصحيح اليدوي عبر رحلة Postman E2E.' }));
// NOTE: there is no student-facing attempt-detail endpoint; final GRADED state
// is asserted in request 18 and verified directly in the database after the run.

item.name: STORY-53 — Promo Code Redemption
item.description: Run after preparing the local environment (npm run postman:prepare:quiz-e2e) with the backend running. Auth is the HttpOnly access_token cookie via the cookie jar; each role logs in before its block. Localized assertions follow {{acceptLanguage}} (en|ar).

exec: pm.test('created code appears as unused', () => pm.expect(data.data.some(c => c.code === pm.environment.get('createdPromoCode'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('promo code marked used with timestamp', () => { pm.expect(data.promoCode.isUsed).to.eql(true); pm.expect(data.promoCode.usedAt).to.be.ok; });
pm.test('redeemed chapter is visible to the student', () => pm.expect(list.some(c => c.id === pm.environment.get('promoChapterId'))).to.be.true);
